title: raw event names on /audit, and pages cut off between 310 and 640 px
note: basis 'shown' means shown by the card's tests or by a local browser walk of the test box's pages; no real box

findings.claim: twelve audit events whose writers name them through a module constant (flow.export, egress.leave, role.acting, dataops.decide and others) had no label, so /audit and its event filter showed their raw names; the label walk read literal names only
findings.fix: this card: the twelve labels in three languages; a walk that resolves the constants

findings.claim: below 640 px html and body clip sideways, so a table with no scroll box, a wide field, a Japanese button label, the save bar and the file field were cut off on 31 of 345 test-box pages between 310 and 619 px, with scrollWidth reading clean
findings.fix: this card: one phone block at the end of console.css; a stylesheet test

findings.claim: no browser runs in CI's unit jobs, so the console's layout tests that open a page skip there; a cut-off page can return without a red test, only the visual job (not required) may show it
findings.fix: for the integrator: a browser in one required job, or the narrow walk in the visual job
